title: The Texan
description:
S01 E08 — The Hemp Tree
Two gunmen rob Bill Longley, taking his $8,300 he earned for taking a herd of cattle to Mesa.

title: The Texan
description:
S01 E09 — The Widow of Paradise
After Longley is forced to kill a barfly that tried to shoot him in the back, he learns a quirk in the Montana law code.

title: The Texan
description:
S01 E10 — Desert Passage
While escorting to prison the leader of a notorious gang, a sheriff and a deputy are attacked by the gang.

title: The Texan
description:
S01 E11 — No Tears for the Dead
While riding down a trail, Bill is accosted by a boy who demands he help his father, who has been shot in the stomach.

title: The Texan
description:
S01 E12 — The Easterner
Bill has been hired to guide two Easterners who want to capture wild stallions to use as studs for breeding.

title: The Texan
description:
S01 E13 — A Time of the Year
A woman dies helping to fight off bandits who try to rob her stagecoach; the unsuccessful bandits try to abduct the town's only doctor to operate on their seriously wounded companion.

title: The Texan
description:
S01 E14 — The Lord Will Provide
After Longley rescues the wounded Reverend Kilgore from two would-be bushwhackers, he learns that the parson was heading for Phillipsburg.

title: The Texan
description:
S01 E15 — The Duchess of Denver
Longley is hired to drive the first herd of cattle directly from the Texas Panhandle to Denver.

title: The Texan
description:
S01 E16 — A Quart of Law
A crooked sheriff and his henchmen are attempting to continue their reign of terror by running a crooked election; Longley persuades an alcoholic former Harvard law professor to stand up to the old sheriff.

title: The Texan
description:
S01 E17 — Outpost
Longley rescues the lone survivor of a murderous stagecoach robbery, but the man refuses to help him identify the three killers.

title: The Texan
description:
S01 E18 — The Peddler
Longley and the town's newspaper editor come to the assistance of a Hungarian peddler when he is attacked by local toughs.

title: The Texan
description:
S01 E19 — Return to Friendly
Longley attempts to escort Yancey Lewis, a bank robber sentenced to spend five years in prison in a distant town.

title: The Texan
description:
S01 E20 — The Man Behind the Star
Longley's old friend, pretty ranch owner Martha Driscoll, negotiates a highly successful sale at the end of a cattle drive.

title: The Texan
description:
S01 E21 — The Ringer
Bill Longley returns from a cattle drive and discovers an impostor has stolen his mail, destroyed a saloon and dallied with a pretty girl, causing his father to demand a shotgun wedding.

title: The Texan
description:
S01 E23 — The Marshal of Yellow Jacket
Longley has just ridden into the town of Yellow Jacket, when he sees a gunman unhitching a team of horses over the loud objections of a pretty woman.

title: The Texan
description:
S01 E24 — No Love Wasted
Wylie Ames, a big gruff widower, has been corresponding with a lonely woman whose personal ad he saw in an out-of town paper.

title: The Texan
description:
S01 E25 — A Race for Life
A crooked gambler with a Kentucky-born thoroughbred prods a drunken rancher into betting his entire spread and all the money he has in the bank on a horse race.

title: The Texan
description:
S01 E26 — Letter Of The Law
Longley rides to the rescue when four gunmen ambush a man riding in a buggy; Longley brings the wounded man to a nearby house, but nobody wants to help him because he's a judge scheduled to preside over the trial of a local land baron.

title: The Texan
description:
S01 E27 — Private Account
Longley, trapped by a landslide, is rescued by a man on the run from the law; he's accused of shooting a man, but the sheriff just assumed he's guilty because he's already served a jail term -- and he's sweet on the sheriff's sister.

title: The Texan
description:
S01 E28 — Caballero
Longley and Acosta travel to San Thomas to bid on a shipment of rifles and ammunition; they're outbid by a beautiful blonde woman working for a notorious gun runner; Longley and Acosta must now prevent the gunrunner's plans to arm the Apaches.

title: The Texan
description:
S01 E29 — Blood Money
Longley stumbles across a cabin and its dead owner; the dead man's brothers believe Longley to be the killer and are preparing to string him up when he's rescued by a stranger.

title: The Texan
description:
S01 E30 — No Place To Stop
Longley must help a parolee and his daughter battle a family of outlaws who are trying to drive him off his ranch; they receive help from a pair of unlikely allies.

title: The Texan
description:
S01 E31 — Reunion
After the surrender at Appomattox, Longley and two of his junior officers agree to a reunion; five years later, the trio rendezvous and the sheriff suspects one of them of stealing an army-payroll.

title: The Texan
description:
S01 E32 — Badlands
Longley chases after Clay Thompson, a ruthless bounty hunter who is pursuit of a man falsely accused of bank robbery; Thompson doesn't believe The Texan when he explains the wanted posters are being retracted and continues his pursuit.

title: The Texan
description:
S01 E33 — South Of The Border
